ownership.quote: The shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on March 28, 2025 under the ticker symbol "CRWV."

stage.quote: CoreWeave, Inc. ("CoreWeave"), the AI Hyperscaler™, announced today the pricing of its initial public offering of 37,500,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $40.00 per share.
stage.note: IPO'd on Nasdaq (CRWV) March 28, 2025 at $40/share, raising ~$1.5B. Prior to the IPO the last priced private round was a Series C (per CoreWeave's FY2025 10-K, which refers to dividends paid on its 'Series C redeemable convertible preferred stock prior to the consummation of our IPO').

total_funding_usd.basis: TechCrunch, quoting the May 2024 Series C close: "the new financing brings CoreWeave's total raised to $5 billion in debt and equity" (pre-IPO cumulative debt+equity, not equity alone; excludes the March 2025 IPO's ~$1.5B and subsequent debt facilities).
total_funding_usd.quote: the new financing brings CoreWeave's total raised to $5 billion in debt and equity – a remarkable figure for a less-than-a-decade-old company.

last_round.quote: CoreWeave ... this week raised $1.1 billion in new funding from investors including Coatue, Fidelity and Altimeter Capital. Reportedly valuing the startup at $19 billion post-money

revenue.basis: FY2025 10-K, Note 15 Geographic Information: total revenue by geography sums to $5,131 million for the year ended December 31, 2025 (vs. $1,915M in 2024 and $229M in 2023).

note: CoreWeave began as a cryptocurrency-mining operation before pivoting to GPU cloud infrastructure for AI. It IPO'd on Nasdaq (CRWV) on March 28, 2025 at $40/share (37.5M shares, ~$1.5B raised), making it a public company; its stage is reported as 'public' rather than the pre-IPO Series C. Pre-IPO backers included Magnetar Capital (an early/recurring investor per CoreWeave's own blog: 'raises $50 million in new capital from Magnetar'), Nvidia (strategic investor), Coatue, Fidelity and Altimeter Capital. FY2025 revenue of $5.13B is for the whole public company (GPU cloud + acquisitions such as Weights & Biases), not specifically the sandbox/agent product line.
